title: ai-overview-presence-tracker.report template variables
description: Values for templates/ai-overview-presence-tracker.report.md.j2 and templates/ai-overview-presence-tracker.report.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from ai-overview-presence-tracker.report.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

adapter.title: Adapter
adapter.description: The AIO scrape adapter used, e.g. SE Ranking AIO tracker. From section 'Scrape configuration'.

country.title: Country
country.description: Two-letter country code the scrape runs in. From section 'Scrape configuration'.

language.title: Language
language.description: Two-letter language code the scrape runs in. From section 'Scrape configuration'.

query_set_version.title: Query set version
query_set_version.description: Version tag of the frozen query set, e.g. v1. From section 'Query set and window'.

tracked_domain.title: Tracked domain
tracked_domain.description: Registrable domain a citation must match, e.g. example-crm.com. From section 'Query set and window'.

window_end.title: Window end
window_end.description: Last day of the 8-week window, YYYY-MM-DD. From section 'Query set and window'.

window_start.title: Window start
window_start.description: First scrape day of the window, YYYY-MM-DD. From section 'Query set and window'.
